title: A Phone Call After Finishing Cancer Treatment
script: Ayu: [thoughtful] Rizal, I just got the scan results. Clear. Officially, formally, clear.
Rizal: Ayu, that's incredible news. I've been holding my breath since you texted you were heading in this morning.
Ayu: [carefully] I thought I'd feel pure relief, unclouded relief, and instead I'm sitting here feeling something considerably more complicated than that.
Rizal: That doesn't surprise me, actually, though I imagine it's confusing to feel anything other than joy after news this good.
Ayu: [reflective] Everyone keeps saying I should be celebrating, and I want to, genuinely, but there's this strange grief underneath the relief that I can't quite explain to anyone.
Rizal: Grief for what, specifically, if you can put words to it?
Ayu: [honestly] For the version of me that existed before any of this, who took her body's cooperation completely for granted, without ever once questioning it.
Rizal: That makes sense. Surviving something doesn't necessarily return you to who you were beforehand, even when the outcome is exactly what everyone hoped for.
Ayu: [gently] There's also this low hum of vigilance now, wondering if every ache is something recurring, when it's probably just an ordinary ache like anyone else's.
Rizal: Do you think that vigilance fades with time, or is it something you'll be managing indefinitely, in some diminished form?
Ayu: [calmly] My oncologist said it typically softens, though rarely vanishes entirely, and honestly, that's a more honest answer than false reassurance would have been.
Rizal: I'd rather you hear the honest version from her than a comforting lie from anyone else, myself included.
Ayu: [encouraging] Thank you for not rushing me toward gratitude today, even though gratitude is genuinely in there somewhere, underneath everything else.
Rizal: You're allowed the complicated version. Nobody survives something like this and comes out the other side uncomplicated.
Ayu: [seriously] I think I needed permission to feel this strangely today, rather than performing the relief everyone was expecting from me.
Rizal: Permission granted, entirely. And congratulations, genuinely, however complicated the feeling underneath it turns out to be.
